content.title: Upgrade to a Pro subscription
content.description: A free account holder upgrades from the dashboard to the Pro plan through an in-app action that completes without full page navigation, records the new plan persistently on the server, confirms success in the same view, and leaves the account in the `pro` state on a fresh fetch or after reload, with no payment-processing step because the upgrade is defined here as a direct state change.
content.summary: Upgrade a Free account to Pro.
content.value: Moves eligible users onto the paid subscription state and ensures the upgrade is durably recorded for later use of Pro capabilities.
criteria: only Free accounts can upgrade, and the target plan is Pro
after a successful upgrade request, the persisted account plan is `pro` and a fresh fetch confirms it rather than cached state
the dashboard triggers the upgrade without full page navigation and shows success confirmation in the same view
upgrade is a direct state change with no payment step

content.title: Access Advanced Reports according to subscription plan
content.description: An account holder uses the dashboard's Advanced Reports feature when the account is on the `pro` plan, in which case the section is visible, its content loads, and direct API access succeeds, while `free` accounts are denied both dashboard and direct-endpoint access and are shown an upgrade prompt instead of report content.
content.summary: Use Advanced Reports with plan-based access.
content.value: Delivers premium functionality to entitled users while enforcing subscription-based access control in both UI and API surfaces.
criteria: Advanced Reports is a Pro-only feature: `pro` accounts can access it and `free` accounts cannot
when the account plan is `pro`, the Advanced Reports section is visible on the dashboard and its content loads successfully
direct requests to the Pro-only API while the plan is `pro` return success (200) with feature content
when the account plan is `free`, the dashboard replaces Advanced Reports with an upgrade prompt instead of feature content
direct requests to the Pro-only API while the plan is `free` return rejected (403) rather than feature content

content.title: View the current subscription plan on the dashboard
content.description: An account holder opens or reloads the dashboard and sees the true, persisted subscription plan fetched from the server—`Free` or `Pro` as currently stored—rather than a hardcoded or stale default, and after an upgrade the indicator must show `Pro` instead of continuing to display `Free`.
content.summary: See the persisted plan on the dashboard.
content.value: Gives users an accurate, current view of their subscription state so the dashboard reflects real account status before and after changes.
criteria: on page load, the dashboard shows the server-persisted plan value, and the supported displayed states are "Free" or "Pro" rather than a hardcoded or stale default
after an upgrade and return or reload, the plan indicator shows "Pro" and must not continue showing "Free"
